stem: Write two sentences about your family. Say how many people are in your family and who they are.
model_answer: There are five people in my family. They are my father, my mother, my two brothers and me.

stem: What do you usually eat for breakfast? Answer in one or two sentences.
model_answer: I usually eat ful and eggs with bread for breakfast. I also drink tea with milk.

stem: Describe your classroom in two sentences.
model_answer: My classroom is big and bright. It has thirty desks, a whiteboard and two windows.

stem: What did you do last Friday? Write two sentences in the past tense.
model_answer: Last Friday I visited my grandparents. We had lunch together and played cards in the evening.

stem: Give directions from your house to the nearest shop in two or three sentences.
model_answer: Go out of my building and turn left. Walk to the end of the street. The shop is on your right, next to the bakery.

stem: Why do people visit the Pyramids of Giza? Give two reasons.
model_answer: People visit the Pyramids because they are very old and famous. They also want to learn about the history of ancient Egypt.

stem: Rewrite this sentence correctly and explain the mistake: "She don't like football."
model_answer: She doesn't like football. With he, she and it we use 'doesn't', not 'don't'.

stem: What is your favourite school subject and why? Answer in two or three sentences.
model_answer: My favourite subject is science because I enjoy doing experiments. It helps me understand the world around me.

stem: Why do we need to drink water every day? Give two reasons.
model_answer: We lose water every day when we sweat and breathe, so we must replace it. Water also helps us digest food and control our body temperature.

stem: Complete the sentence "If I had more free time, ..." and then write one more sentence explaining your answer.
model_answer: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar. I have always loved music, but I am too busy with homework now.

stem: Explain why the River Nile is important to Egypt. Answer in two or three sentences.
model_answer: The Nile gives Egypt most of its fresh water for drinking and farming. Most Egyptians live near it because the rest of the country is desert.

stem: Do you think students should wear school uniforms? Give your opinion and one reason.
model_answer: Yes, I think students should wear uniforms because they make everyone equal and save time in the morning.

stem: Explain in two or three sentences why plants need sunlight.
model_answer: Plants need sunlight to make their own food by photosynthesis. The leaves use light energy to turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen.

stem: Write two sentences comparing life in Cairo with life in a village. Use a comparative form in each sentence.
model_answer: Life in Cairo is busier and noisier than life in a village. However, people in a village usually know their neighbours better than people in a big city.

stem: Change this into reported speech: My teacher said, "I will give you a test next week." Then write one sentence about how you feel about it.
model_answer: My teacher said that she would give us a test the following week. I feel a little nervous, but I will revise every day.

stem: Write 4-5 sentences about your best friend. Say who he or she is, what he or she looks like and what you do together.
model_answer: My best friend is Omar. He is twelve years old and he lives in my street. He is tall and he has short black hair. We go to the same school and we play football together after school. I like him because he is kind and funny.

stem: Write 4-5 sentences about your daily routine on a school day.
model_answer: I get up at six o'clock every morning. First, I wash my face and have breakfast with my family. Then I take the school bus at seven. After school I have lunch and do my homework. I go to bed at ten o'clock.

stem: Write 4-6 sentences describing your home.
model_answer: I live in a flat in Mansoura. It is on the third floor. There are three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. My favourite room is my bedroom because it is quiet. From the balcony I can see the Nile.

stem: Write 5-6 sentences about your last holiday. Where did you go, who did you go with and what did you do?
model_answer: Last summer I went to Marsa Matrouh with my family. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. Every morning we swam in the sea and in the evening we walked on the Corniche. One day we visited Cleopatra's Bath. It was a wonderful holiday and I want to go back next year.

stem: Write 5-6 sentences describing how your family celebrates a feast in Egypt, for example Eid or Sham El-Nessim.
model_answer: My family celebrates Eid al-Fitr every year. On the first morning we wear new clothes and go to the Eid prayer. After that we visit our grandparents and eat kahk together. The children get money called eidiya from the adults. In the afternoon we go to the park or the cinema. Eid is my favourite time of the year.

stem: Write 5-7 sentences about a famous place in Egypt that you would like to visit and why.
model_answer: I would like to visit Abu Simbel in Aswan. It has two huge temples that King Ramses II built more than 3,000 years ago. I want to see the big statues at the entrance. I also read that the sun lights up the inside of the temple twice a year. Moreover, I would like to take a boat on Lake Nasser. I hope I can go there with my class next year.

stem: Write an email of 5-7 sentences to a friend inviting him or her to your birthday party. Include the day, the time, the place and what you will do.
model_answer: Hi Mariam, How are you? I'm having a birthday party next Friday and I would love you to come. It starts at five o'clock at my house in Nasr City. We will eat cake, play games and watch a film together. Please tell me by Wednesday if you can come. See you soon, Nour

stem: Write 5-7 sentences about the advantages of learning English.
model_answer: Learning English has many advantages. First, it is the language of international communication, so it helps us talk to people from other countries. Second, a lot of information on the internet is in English. In addition, many good jobs in Egypt, especially in tourism and technology, require English. It also makes travelling and studying abroad much easier. For these reasons, I think every student should work hard to improve their English.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences: Should mobile phones be allowed in school? Give your opinion with reasons.
model_answer: In my opinion, mobile phones should not be allowed in class, but students may keep them in their bags. On the one hand, phones are useful in an emergency and can help us look up information. On the other hand, many students play games or chat during lessons, which distracts them and their classmates. Phones can also be used to cheat in exams. Therefore, I think the best solution is to switch them off during lessons. Teachers could allow them only for special activities. This way we get the benefits without the problems.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences explaining how we can save water at home and at school.
model_answer: Egypt depends on the Nile and does not have much water, so we must not waste it. At home, we should turn off the tap while we brush our teeth. We can also take short showers instead of baths and repair leaking taps quickly. When we wash the dishes, it is better to fill the sink than to leave the water running. At school, students can report broken taps to the teachers. In addition, the school garden can be watered early in the morning so less water evaporates. If everyone does these small things, we can save a lot of water.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences about a person who has influenced you and explain how.
model_answer: The person who has influenced me most is my grandfather. He was a teacher in a village school for forty years. When I was young, he used to tell me stories about history every evening. Because of him, I started reading books and I fell in love with learning. He also taught me to be patient and to respect other people. Although he is old now, he still reads the newspaper every morning. I hope I will become a teacher like him one day.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences: Is it better to live in a big city or in the countryside? Give reasons for your opinion.
model_answer: Although the countryside is peaceful, I believe living in a big city is better for young people. Cities offer more opportunities for education, since most universities are located there. Moreover, there are more jobs and better hospitals. On the other hand, cities are crowded and polluted, and life is more expensive. The countryside has fresh air and a slower pace of life, which is good for older people. Nevertheless, for someone who wants to study and build a career, the city is the better choice.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences about the problem of traffic in Cairo and suggest some solutions.
model_answer: Traffic jams are one of the biggest problems in Cairo. Millions of people drive to work every day, and many roads are too narrow for this number of cars. As a result, people waste hours in traffic and the air becomes polluted. One solution is to improve public transport, for example by building more metro lines and buses. The government could also encourage companies to let employees work from home some days. In addition, drivers should respect traffic rules, because accidents make jams worse. If these steps are taken, life in Cairo will become much easier.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences: Some people say homework should be banned. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons.
model_answer: I partly disagree with the idea of banning homework. Homework helps students practise what they learned in class and remember it for longer. It also teaches them to organise their time and work independently. However, too much homework can make students tired and leave no time for sport or family. Therefore, I think teachers should give short, useful tasks instead of long ones. In this way, homework would support learning without causing stress.

stem: Write 6-8 sentences explaining the causes of climate change and how it affects Egypt.
model_answer: Climate change is mainly caused by burning fossil fuels such as oil, coal and gas, which release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. Cutting down forests also makes the problem worse because trees absorb this gas. As a result, the Earth is getting warmer. In Egypt, summers are becoming hotter, which is dangerous for health and for crops. Rising sea levels threaten the Nile Delta and cities like Alexandria. Furthermore, less water may reach Egypt if rainfall in the Nile basin changes. To reduce these effects, Egypt is investing in solar and wind energy.
